clue_knocks_distant.title: The three knocks (from the street)
clue_knocks_distant.description: Knock, knock… knock: hollow wooden knocks inside the blue house, muffled by the wall, with a little echo off the neighbouring houses.
clue_knocks_distant.purpose: Arrival clue: raises 'Where are the knocks coming from?'. Mono, so the game places it at the house (direction and distance come from the 3D position).
clue_knocks_distant.listen_for: Are all three knocks distinct on the phone speaker, with the pause before the last? Does it sound like it is inside a house, not in your ear, and still friendly rather than scary?

clue_floor_hum.title: Floor hum and knocks (inside the hall)
clue_floor_hum.description: The floor starts to hum and tremble, three knocks thump up through the boards with a rattle of dust, then the hum fades.
clue_floor_hum.purpose: Hall clue: becomes the floor-hum sticker; the knocks are under the floor.
clue_floor_hum.listen_for: Can you hear the hum on the phone (it is built from overtones, the speaker has no deep bass)? Do the knocks feel under your feet rather than on a door?

clue_cam_tap.title: Cam tap (workshop, close up)
clue_cam_tap.description: A hard little wooden 'tok': the cam lobe tapping its follower, with a tiny settle.
clue_cam_tap.purpose: Workshop: the machine's knock source seen and heard close up; plays on each cam contact.
clue_cam_tap.listen_for: Does it read as the same family as the knocks, only closer and harder?

clue_wind_wheel.title: Wind wheel whirr (rooftop)
clue_wind_wheel.description: The little rooftop wheel spins up, whirrs and slows, with a soft axle creak.
clue_wind_wheel.purpose: Bonus clue seen from the treehouse deck: it whirs before each knock cycle.
clue_wind_wheel.listen_for: Whirr, not buzz? It should sound wooden and breezy.

step_wood.title: Footsteps on wood
step_wood.description: Pip's light heel-and-toe on porch planks; one take has a tiny creak.
step_wood.purpose: Porch, treehouse and the house interior floors.
step_wood.listen_for: In the walk preview: do steps vary enough not to sound like a machine gun? Light, a child?

step_grass.title: Footsteps on grass
step_grass.description: Soft brushy lawn steps with a gentle earth thud.
step_grass.listen_for: Grass, or does it sound like paper? Too hissy on the phone?

step_stone.title: Footsteps on stone
step_stone.description: Crisp, small soft-sole ticks on paving with a little grit.
step_stone.purpose: Sidewalk, plaza and the porch steps.
step_stone.listen_for: Soft costume shoes, not high heels or tap shoes?

move_jump.title: Jump
move_jump.description: A soft push-off and the cape whooshing up with a couple of flaps.
move_jump.purpose: Every jump; layered with the high-jump boost later.
move_jump.listen_for: Light and springy, not a sword swish?

move_land.title: Land
move_land.description: A light thud, two quick soles, one cape flutter and a puff of dust.
move_land.purpose: Every landing (spec §5: soft footfall, one flutter of the cape).

move_glide_open.title: Glide: cape opens
move_glide_open.description: 'Fwup': the bat cape spreads, then flutters in the air and folds.
move_glide_open.purpose: Start of the bat-cape glide, Pip's signature move.
move_glide_open.listen_for: Does it sound like fabric wings? Is the flutter pleasant rather than a motor?

move_glide_loop.title: Glide: flutter loop
move_glide_loop.description: A seamless two-second flutter that repeats while the glide lasts.
move_glide_loop.purpose: Held glide (loops under the opening sound).
move_glide_loop.listen_for: With the player looping: can you hear the seam or a repeating pattern?

ui_page_turn.title: Page turn (threshold)
ui_page_turn.description: A big paper page lifting, sweeping over and landing with a soft flap.
ui_page_turn.purpose: The 0.5 s paper page-turn transition at the house thresholds (D24.1); also the notebook page flip.
ui_page_turn.listen_for: Paper, not wind or a shaker? Does it fit a half-second transition?

note_sticker_pick.title: Sticker: pick up
note_sticker_pick.description: A sticker peeling off its backing: rising crackle and a small 'tk'.
note_sticker_pick.purpose: Lifting a clue sticker from the tray (mystery-first §5).
note_sticker_pick.listen_for: Satisfying peel? Not scratchy or harsh on the phone?

note_sticker_drop.title: Sticker: press in
note_sticker_drop.description: A soft felt pat with a small wooden 'tuk' and the glue gripping.
note_sticker_drop.purpose: Placing a sticker on a question slot.
note_sticker_drop.listen_for: Does it feel like pressing something down, tactile and cosy?

note_sticker_wobble.title: Sticker: wobble back
note_sticker_wobble.description: A friendly rubbery 'boing-oing' and a soft 'tok' as the sticker hops home.
note_sticker_wobble.purpose: A wrong set: gentle, never a failure buzzer (D26).
note_sticker_wobble.listen_for: Playful 'try again', not 'wrong!'? Would a 6-year-old smile?

note_correct_glow.title: Correct: glow
note_correct_glow.description: A warm rising celesta arpeggio that blooms into a soft glow with sparkles.
note_correct_glow.purpose: A right placement: the answer appears (no fanfare, a warm reward).
note_correct_glow.listen_for: Warm and magical, not a slot-machine win? Not too long?

ui_tap.title: UI tap
ui_tap.description: A short, soft wooden 'tup' of a felt button.
ui_tap.purpose: Every button and control (spec §6: sound on every control).
ui_tap.listen_for: Pleasant after 100 taps? Too clicky or too dull?

voice_pip.title: Babble: Pip
voice_pip.description: The curious new kid: a bright child voice, medium pace, questions that rise.
voice_pip.purpose: Non-verbal babble under the caption when the character speaks (D20, D23.1). Each take is a different line.
voice_pip.listen_for: Does it sound like this character? Cute and kind, never creepy or robotic? Too buzzy?

voice_bea.title: Babble: Bea
voice_bea.description: Fast and sure: higher, quicker, bouncier.
voice_bea.purpose: Non-verbal babble under the caption when the character speaks (D20, D23.1). Each take is a different line.
voice_bea.listen_for: Does it sound like this character? Cute and kind, never creepy or robotic? Too buzzy?

voice_vale.title: Babble: Mr. Vale
voice_vale.description: Slow and dry: a kind old man, narrow melody, a gentle creak at the end of a thought.
voice_vale.purpose: Non-verbal babble under the caption when the character speaks (D20, D23.1). Each take is a different line.
voice_vale.listen_for: Does it sound like this character? Cute and kind, never creepy or robotic? Too buzzy?

voice_june.title: Babble: June
voice_june.description: Conspiratorial: half-whispered, close, quick little bursts and a giggle.
voice_june.purpose: Non-verbal babble under the caption when the character speaks (D20, D23.1). Each take is a different line.
voice_june.listen_for: Does it sound like this character? Cute and kind, never creepy or robotic? Too buzzy?

voice_kit.title: Babble: Aunt Kit
voice_kit.description: Theatrical: wide swoops, warm vibrato, generous vowels.
voice_kit.purpose: Non-verbal babble under the caption when the character speaks (D20, D23.1). Each take is a different line.
voice_kit.listen_for: Does it sound like this character? Cute and kind, never creepy or robotic? Too buzzy?

amb_night.title: Night ambience loop
amb_night.description: A gentle autumn night: soft gusts of wind, leaves skittering, two far-off crickets. Stereo, 24 s, loops seamlessly.
amb_night.purpose: Bed under the street (spec §6: ambient life that never competes with evidence).
amb_night.listen_for: Calm, not spooky-scary? Is the loop point audible? Are the crickets too sharp?

music_motif_pluck.title: Motif: plucked (opening)
music_motif_pluck.description: The three-note motif in the knock rhythm (short, short, long) on a soft plucked string.
music_motif_pluck.purpose: Opening music seed (spec §6: sparse plucked strings).
music_motif_pluck.listen_for: Gentle and curious? Does the string sound like a real instrument?

music_motif_wood.title: Motif: wood with a warm chord (closure)
music_motif_wood.description: The same motif on a wooden marimba, then a warmer rolled D major chord.
music_motif_wood.purpose: Case closure (spec §6: the motif on wood with a warmer final chord).
music_motif_wood.listen_for: Does the final chord feel warm and 'case solved'?
